requiredScope: All earlier obligations, additional row expressions and the other grammar families remain in scope.

Rows/ValueRow.role: A nonempty ordered row of independent scalar operands.
Rows/ValueRow.structure: An ordered list of integer, NULL, numbered parameter and arithmetic values.
Rows/ValueRow.boundary: At most 2000 values. Every arithmetic subtree has an empty table scope. The usual height and expanded node bounds apply.
Rows/ValueRow.meaning: Evaluate each expression without a local relation, retaining its value and storage class at the given position.
Rows/ValueRow.sql: Emit one parenthesized list, preserving lexical parameter order.

Rows/Values.structure: A nonempty ordered list of checked rows of a single width.
Rows/Values.boundary: The row widths agree. The whole statement meets the expansion and parameter label budgets.
Rows/Values.meaning: Return a bag with one result row per operand row. SQLite supplies result names column1 through columnN. No order is promised.
Rows/Values.sql: Emit VALUES followed by rows in their recorded order.

analysis: Lower a top-level VALUES clause using the same scalar semantics as SELECT on an empty local scope. Supported operands are signed decimal integers, NULL, numbered parameters and the supported binary arithmetic. Compound queries, other value expressions and other statement uses remain open.
